items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: my cousin, James Backnitude, he showed me one piece, My Country Tisley, on the piano and from then on I just picked up the piano.

ctx.x: Same thing as Danny Barker, he told me that same thing, a lot of guys did that. That's what I did.

But Danny Banger also, they all started like that. I tuned it in ukulele and played that night and I made, I made good that night, so I stayed with the band. Before the banjo or after the... No, that was before the banjo. I just, I had, let me see, my cousin, James Backnitude, he showed me one piece, My Country Tisley, on the piano and from then on I just picked up the piano. What's the first tune you learned on any instrument? I'm telling you, My Country Tisley was... No, but I mean on anything, not just piano.…
What's the first tune you learned on ukulele?
